questionHi: क्या BRICS Summit के दौरान पूरी Delhi बंद रहेगी?
questionEn: Will the whole of Delhi be shut during the BRICS Summit?
answerHi: नहीं, पूरी Delhi बंद नहीं रहेगी। Traffic restrictions मुख्य रूप से Summit venue, VIP movement वाले routes और security-sensitive areas में हो सकती हैं। बाकी Delhi में traffic सामान्य रूप से चलता रहेगा। हालांकि VIP movement के दौरान कुछ routes पर थोड़ी देर के लिए traffic रोका या divert किया जा सकता है।
answerEn: No, the whole of Delhi will not be shut. Traffic restrictions will mainly apply around the Summit venue, on routes used for VIP movement, and in security-sensitive areas. Traffic in the rest of Delhi will keep running normally. That said, during VIP movement some routes may be held or diverted for a short while.

questionHi: Controlled Zone और Regulated Zone में क्या फर्क है?
questionEn: What is the difference between a Controlled Zone and a Regulated Zone?
answerHi: Controlled Zone में security ज्यादा tight होगी और entry केवल authorized लोगों को लागू नियमों के अनुसार मिलेगी। Regulated Zone में सामान्य traffic चलता रहेगा, लेकिन VIP movement या security requirement के समय traffic को temporarily regulate किया जा सकता है।
answerEn: In a Controlled Zone security will be tighter and entry will be given only to authorised people, as per the rules in force. In a Regulated Zone normal traffic will keep moving, but traffic can be regulated temporarily when there is VIP movement or a security requirement.

questionHi: अगर मुझे रास्ता नहीं पता हो तो क्या करूं?

answerHi: चलती गाड़ी में mobile देखकर route खोजने की कोशिश न करें। Safe जगह पर रुककर navigation check करें या traffic police से मदद लें। Safety से compromise करके route खोजने की कोशिश न करें।
answerEn: Do not try to find a route by looking at your mobile while driving. Stop at a safe place and check navigation, or take help from the traffic police. Do not try to find a route by compromising on safety.

questionHi: क्या traffic restrictions के दौरान जल्दी-जल्दी driving करना safe है?
questionEn: Is it safe to drive fast during traffic restrictions?
answerHi: नहीं। Changed routes और restrictions के दौरान जल्दबाजी accident का risk बढ़ाती है। Speed limit, lane discipline और traffic police के instructions follow करें।
answerEn: No. During changed routes and restrictions, hurrying increases the risk of an accident. Follow the speed limit, lane discipline and the instructions of the traffic police.

questionHi: क्या लंबी यात्रा से पहले vehicle में पर्याप्त fuel रखना चाहिए?
questionEn: Should I keep enough fuel in the vehicle before a long journey?
answerHi: हां। लंबी journey से पहले fuel और vehicle की basic condition check कर लें। Traffic restrictions के कारण journey time बढ़ सकता है।
answerEn: Yes. Before a long journey, check the fuel and the basic condition of your vehicle. Journey time can increase because of traffic restrictions.

questionHi: क्या यात्रा से पहले vehicle की basic checking करनी चाहिए?
questionEn: Should I do a basic check of the vehicle before travelling?
answerHi: हां। Tyre, brake, fuel, battery, lights और जरूरी documents check कर लें। Breakdown से road पर unnecessary congestion हो सकता है।
answerEn: Yes. Check the tyres, brakes, fuel, battery, lights and the necessary documents. A breakdown can cause unnecessary congestion on the road.

questionHi: अगर कोई व्यक्ति जानबूझकर traffic rules तोड़ रहा हो तो क्या करें?
questionEn: What should I do if someone is deliberately breaking traffic rules?
answerHi: खुद उससे बहस या confrontation न करें। अगर उसकी driving से immediate danger या serious traffic problem हो रही है तो safe distance से traffic police को information दें।
answerEn: Do not argue or get into a confrontation with them yourself. If their driving is causing immediate danger or a serious traffic problem, give the information to the traffic police from a safe distance.

questionHi: BRICS Summit के दौरान सबसे safe traffic strategy क्या है?
questionEn: What is the safest traffic strategy during the BRICS Summit?
answerHi: Journey पहले plan करें, official traffic advisory देखें, possible हो तो Metro या public transport लें, extra buffer time रखें और मौके पर traffic police के instructions follow करें।
answerEn: Plan your journey in advance, look at the official traffic advisory, take the Metro or public transport if possible, keep extra buffer time, and follow the instructions of the traffic police on the spot.
